positive_snippets:
Had a really pleasant stay here. The biggest advantage is the location—the hotel is right next to the Blue Line metro station, which makes traveling around the city extremely easy. 🚇

There’s also a mall nearby, along with plenty of cafes, restaurants, and small eateries within walking distance, so finding good food or a place to relax was never a problem. Everything you need is just around the corner. ☕🍽️

The rooms were clean, comfortable, and well maintained, and the staff was polite and helpful throughout the stay. Overall, it’s a great place if you want a comfortable stay in a prime, well-connected area. I’d definitely recommend it and would happily stay here again.

very good facility in this service renge.. service & hospitality is the most valuable and important thing here.. feel like home.
staff service and owners coordinations are really appreciable.
Prompt service provided. Appreciated. Neat and clean rooms and especially washrooms. Staff is helpful and location is very prime.
negative_snippets:
One of the worst hotels I’ve stayed in, especially for the price (₹2000).
The room was extremely dirty — walls had spit marks and stains that made it hard to even eat inside. The bathroom flush was broken too.
Overall, a very disappointing experience.
The hotel should seriously consider cleaning and repainting the rooms before renting them out.
